description_en: Queries the Virtual Border Routers (VBRs) under a specified Express Connect circuit, including VBRs owned by the circuit owner and VBRs owned by other accounts
description_zh: 查询指定物理专线下的边界路由器（VBR），包括物理专线所有者的VBR和其他账号的VBR
name: DescribeVirtualBorderRoutersForPhysicalConnection

parameters.help_en: The region where the Express Connect circuit is deployed. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 物理专线所在的地域。 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html 接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50。默认值为10。
parameters.name: page_size

element_fields.help_en:
The filter condition. You can specify up to five filter conditions. The following filter conditions are supported:

PhysicalConnectionId: instance ID of the Express Connect circuit instance.

VbrId: instance ID of the Virtual Border Router instance.

Status: the status of the Virtual Border Router.

Name: the name of the Virtual Border Router.

AccessPointId: instance ID of the access point.

eccId: instance ID of the Express Cloud Connect instance.

type: the type of the Virtual Border Router
element_fields.help_zh:
过滤条件，最多可提供5个过滤条件。支持如下过滤条件：

PhysicalConnectionId：物理专线实例ID。

VbrId：边界路由器实例ID。

Status：边界路由器状态。

Name：边界路由器名称。

AccessPointId：接入点ID。

eccId：高速上云服务实例ID。

type：边界路由器类型
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The filter value based on the specified Key. You can specify multiple filter values for a Key. The relationship between filter values is OR, which means that a match with any filter value is considered a match for the filter condition
element_fields.help_zh: 根据Key指定过滤值。一个Key支持指定多个过滤值，每个过滤值之间是或的关系，即只要符合其中一个过滤值，则视为匹配该过滤条件
element_fields.name: value

v1_parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
v1_parameters.name: PageNumber

v1_parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
v1_parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50。默认值为10
v1_parameters.name: PageSize

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit
